subtitle: Set up your profile in a few easy steps
safeguarding_subtitle: Let us know if you'd like additional support
safeguarding_intro: Your safety matters to us. If you would like extra support while using this community, let us know below. Each choice tells you exactly what it does before you pick it. Your answers are confidential and only visible to community coordinators — never on your public profile.
safeguarding_gdpr_notice: This information is classified as sensitive personal data. We collect it solely to ensure your safety during community exchanges. Your selections are stored with a consent record and can be changed at any time from your settings. Only community coordinators and administrators can view your responses.
welcome_description: Let's set up your profile so you can start connecting with your community and exchanging time credits.
benefit_earn_desc: Help others and earn credits you can spend on services you need
benefit_community_desc: Connect with neighbours and strengthen local bonds
benefit_skills_desc: Offer your talents and discover what your community can do
profile_description: Add a photo and tell the community about yourself. This helps members recognise and trust you.
photo_drag_hint: JPG, PNG, GIF or WebP, up to 5 MB
bio_placeholder: Tell the community about yourself — your interests, skills, or what you hope to get from timebanking...
bio_min_chars: A few more words, please — at least {{min}} characters ({{current}}/{{min}})
validation_bio: A few words about you ({{min}} characters or more)
location_error_location: We could not save that place. Please check it and try again.
location_error_coordinates: We could not use the map position for that place. Please pick it from the list again, or type just your town.
skills_offer_description: Pick things you could help others with, or add your own. They go on your profile and help us match you with people who need them.
skills_need_description: Pick what you'd like help with, or add your own. We use this to suggest people and offers that fit.
aria_take_photo: Take a profile photo with your camera
toast_invalid_file_type: We can't use that kind of file
toast_invalid_file_type_desc: Try a JPG, PNG, GIF or WebP picture.
toast_upload_failed_desc: Please try again in a moment.
toast_photo_required: Add a profile photo to carry on
toast_photo_required_desc: It helps other members recognise and trust you.
toast_bio_required: Tell us a little about yourself
toast_bio_required_desc: Write at least {{min}} characters to carry on.
toast_save_failed_desc: Your profile wasn't saved. Please try again.
toast_categories_failed: We couldn't load the list of skills
toast_something_went_wrong: That didn't work — sorry. Please try again.

toast_photo_bio_required: Add a photo and a few words about yourself.

safeguarding.empty: No safeguarding options have been configured for this community.

confirmation.title: Your safeguarding preferences have been saved
confirmation.intro: Thank you for sharing this. Here is a summary of what you chose, who can see it, and what activates as a result.
confirmation.no_selections: You did not select any safeguarding options.
confirmation.who_can_see_body: Only the community coordinators and administrators can see these preferences. Other members cannot. All access is logged.
confirmation.activation_broker_review: A coordinator (also called a broker) checks and approves exchanges and matches involving you before they go ahead. This does not let them read your messages.
confirmation.activation_match_approval: A coordinator checks each match suggested for you before you or the other member are told about it. This does not let them read your messages.
confirmation.activation_discovery_hidden: You will be hidden from discovery for members who have not completed the required vetting.
confirmation.activation_notification: A coordinator has been notified and will be in touch to discuss how we can help.
confirmation.activation_none: No automatic protections activate from these selections. Your preferences are recorded for coordinator awareness.
confirmation.revoke_heading: How to change or revoke these at any time
confirmation.revoke_body: You can review or revoke any of these preferences any time from your profile settings. You do not need to ask an administrator to do this.
confirmation.declination_intro: Thank you for reviewing these options. Your response has been saved so coordinators know you have seen and considered this step.

safeguarding.answer_missing: Please choose at least one option before you continue.
safeguarding.answer_missing_with_none: Please choose at least one option. If none of them apply to you, choose “{{none}}”.

security_subtitle: Optional: add a second check when you sign in
security_intro: Two-factor authentication keeps your account safe even if someone finds out your password. When you sign in, you enter your password as usual, then a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone.
security_need_phone: Your phone, with a free authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy
security_need_password: The password you use for this account
security_optional_note: This is optional. If you prefer, choose "Not now" — you can set it up later in Settings, under Security.
security_confirm_failed_hint: If you can't confirm with a password here, choose "Not now" to carry on. You can set this up later in Settings, under Security.
security_on_body: From now on, when you sign in you'll enter a code from your authenticator app as well as your password. You can manage it in Settings, under Security.
